name: CSP weekly scenarios (synthetic July week)
note: Standalone 7-day CSP/TES experiment (CSP/csp_weekly_scenarios.jl): Mon 2024-07-01 .. Sun 2024-07-07, one 168-hour LP per weather scenario. In the CSP tab the gate selector switches between A: clear skies / B: mixed sun and cloud / C: full overcast to compare the hourly trends. Fully synthetic inputs (Spanish July price shape, demo-scale plant, physical leak 0.0005/h, persistence continuation value): the Price tab shows scenario B's synthetic day-ahead week; every other market section is a placeholder because this run never touched the market chain.
